---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon, Circle, Ellipse
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/punts-municipis.json').read_text())
stats={row['code']:row for row in d['municipalities']}
names={'430957':'El Morell','430430':'El Catllar','430477':'Constantí'}
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'punts-municipis'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(11.5,5.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.025,right=.975,bottom=.22,top=.78,wspace=.07)
for ax,record in zip(axes,d['maps']):
    row=stats[record['code']];s=row['all'];g=record['boundary']
    parts=g['coordinates'] if g['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [g['coordinates']]
    for part in parts:
        ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.asarray(part[0])[:,:2]/1000,facecolor='#f2f5f7',edgecolor='#9aa5ae',lw=1.1))
        for hole in part[1:]:ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.asarray(hole)[:,:2]/1000,facecolor='white',edgecolor='#9aa5ae',lw=1.1))
    xy=np.asarray(record['points'])/1000;centre=np.asarray(s['centre'])/1000
    half=max(float(np.max(np.abs(xy-centre))),s['sd_m']/1000)*1.18+.1
    ax.scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],s=17,color='#597b8b',alpha=.8,zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(Circle(centre,s['sd_m']/1000,fill=False,edgecolor='#b87924',ls='--',lw=2.2,zorder=4))
    a,b=np.asarray(s['semiaxes_m'])/1000
    ax.add_patch(Ellipse(centre,2*a,2*b,angle=s['angle_east_deg'],fill=False,edgecolor='#006699',lw=2.4,zorder=5))
    ax.scatter(*centre,s=75,marker='D',color='#a73543',edgecolor='white',linewidth=.6,zorder=6)
    radius=f"{s['sd_m']:.0f}"
    ax.set_title(f"{names[record['code']]}\n{s['n']} registres · radi {radius} m",fontsize=18,pad=15)
    ax.set(xlim=(centre[0]-half,centre[0]+half),ylim=(centre[1]-half,centre[1]+half),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[])
    length=.5 if half<1.5 else 2
    left=centre[0]-half+.12*2*half;bottom=centre[1]-half+.13*2*half
    ax.plot([left,left+length],[bottom,bottom],color='#233947',lw=3,zorder=7)
    ax.text(left+length/2,bottom-.03*2*half,f'{length:g} km'.replace('.',','),ha='center',va='top',fontsize=17,zorder=8)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():spine.set_color('#bdc7cf')
fig.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='D',color='#a73543',ls='',label='Centre mitjà'),
    Line2D([],[],color='#b87924',ls='--',lw=2,label='Cercle de dispersió'),
    Line2D([],[],color='#006699',lw=2,label='El·lipse de dispersió')],
    loc='lower center',bbox_to_anchor=(.5,.015),ncol=2,frameon=False,fontsize=18)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/punts-municipis.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
